title: Dialogue
description: A branching conversation: the start node and the nodes it reaches, by id. A choice with no next ends the conversation. The loader also checks what this schema cannot: the start node exists, every next names a node, each node has 1 to 9 choices, text is not blank, and every node is reachable from start.

start.description: Id of the node the conversation opens on

nodes.description: Every node of the conversation, keyed by node id. Cycles back to earlier nodes are allowed.

overrides.description: If present, this dialogue overrides another dialogue with the same id

text.description: The NPC's line at this node

choices.description: The player's choices at this node: 1 to 9, numbered from 1 in the popup

next.description: Id of the node this choice leads to. Omit to end the conversation.
